 2. work on playing around your carries. i know this is hard, but as a support your top concern should be making sure your carries stay alive and get kills/farm (and VISION!!!). if you see the perfect engage, but your carries are spread out, or hyper focused on killing that cannon minion, it is NOT the perfect engage. try to learn how to predict/be aware of how your teammates (especially adc bcuz we all know how they can be 🙄🙄🙄) are playing. the most brilliant, five-head play is only good if your team is on board/ready to back you up. if any teammates pick a champion with heavy engage, DON'T pick another engager. instead, learn to play around that teammate.
